ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Spiritual radiance is a brilliant or far-reaching light said to shine, fill space, or appear around a person.
EvidenceBody: Speakers release it, call it solitary and enduring, or place its illumination across vast distance.

Senses.Note: 5 exact witnesses from 5 independent works delimit this sense.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Shenguang is the name borne by Huike before Bodhidharma renamed him.
